name: WholeStack WF-030: Property Candidate Fan-In & Evidence Aggregator

parameters.jsCode: const b=$input.first().json.body||$input.first().json; const criteria=[...new Set((Array.isArray(b.criteria)?b.criteria:[]).map(x=>String(x).trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean))]; const keyFor=r=>{const parcel=keyPart(r.parcel_id||r.source_record_id); const addr=keyPart(r.property_address); const owner=keyPart(r.owner_name); if(parcel) return 'parcel:'+parcel; if(addr&&owner) return 'owner-address:'+owner+'|'+addr; if(addr) return 'address:'+addr; if(r.source_record_id) return 'source:'+keyPart(r.source_record_id); return null;}; const buckets=new Map(); const mergeEvidence=(bucket,r)=>{const evidence={source_url:r.source_url||null,source_name:r.source_name||r.source||null,source_type:r.source_type||r.type||null,source_record_id:r.source_record_id||null,observed_at:r.source_observed_at||r.observed_at||null,confidence:r.confidence??null,criterion_signals:r.criterion_signals||r.signals||{},criterion_evidence:r.criterion_evidence||null,raw_attributes:r.raw_attributes||null}; const ek=JSON.stringify([evidence.source_url,evidence.source_record_id,evidence.source_type]); if(!bucket._evidenceKeys.has(ek)){bucket._evidenceKeys.add(ek); bucket.evidence.push(evidence);} }; for(const r of sources){if(!r||typeof r!=='object') continue; for(const f of fields){if(bucket.candidate[f]==null&&r[f]!=null&&r[f]!=='') bucket.candidate[f]=r[f];} if(Array.isArray(r.distress_signals)) bucket.candidate.distress_signals=[...new Set([...(bucket.candidate.distress_signals||[]),...r.distress_signals])]; if(r.criterion_signals&&typeof r.criterion_signals==='object') bucket.candidate.criterion_signals={...(bucket.candidate.criterion_signals||{}),...r.criterion_signals}; if(r.criterion_match_count!=null) bucket.candidate.criterion_match_count=Math.max(bucket.candidate.criterion_match_count||0,Number(r.criterion_match_count)||0); const terms={tax_delinquent:['delinquent','past due','tax lien'],vacant:['vacant','no structure','unoccupied'],vacant_land:['vacant land','land only'],absentee:['mailing address','absentee'],probate:['probate','estate'],pre_foreclosure:['foreclosure','lis pendens','default'],fixer_upper:['permit','violation','inspection','repair','condition'],distressed:['delinquent','foreclosure','violation','permit','code enforcement']}[c]||[]; return terms.some(t=>ev.includes(t))?1:0;}; const ranked=[...buckets.values()].map(bucket=>{const c=bucket.candidate; const matched=criteria.filter(x=>bucket.evidence.some(e=>explicitSignal(x,e))); const sourceTypes=[...new Set(bucket.evidence.map(e=>e.source_type).filter(Boolean))]; const sourceCount=bucket.evidence.length; const score=Math.min(100,sourceCount*8+matched.length*18+(c.parcel_id?8:0)+(c.owner_name?5:0)+(c.property_address?5:0)); return {...c, candidate_key:bucket.key, evidence:bucket.evidence, evidence_count:sourceCount, evidence_source_types:sourceTypes, matched_criteria:matched, criterion_match_count:matched.length, candidate_score:score, evidence_status:matched.length===criteria.length&&criteria.length>0?'criterion_supported':(matched.length?'partial_support':'identity_only')}; }).sort((a,b)=>b.candidate_score-a.candidate_score||String(a.candidate_key).localeCompare(String(b.candidate_key))); const limit=Math.min(50,Math.max(1,Number(b.limit||25))); return [{json:{success:true,request_id:b.request_id||null,state:b.state||null,county:b.county||null,criteria,source_counts:{gis:Array.isArray(b.gis_records)?b.gis_records.length:0,non_arcgis:Array.isArray(b.non_arcgis_records)?b.non_arcgis_records.length:0,criterion_evidence:Array.isArray(b.criterion_evidence)?b.criterion_evidence.length:0,total:sources.length},candidate_records:ranked.slice(0,limit),candidate_count:Math.min(ranked.length,limit),dedupe_count:Math.max(0,sources.length-ranked.length),limitations:[...(Array.isArray(b.gis_limitations)?b.gis_limitations:[]),...(Array.isArray(b.non_arcgis_limitations)?b.non_arcgis_limitations:[]),...(Array.isArray(b.criterion_evidence_limitations)?b.criterion_evidence_limitations:[])],policy:'Deterministic evidence fan-in only.
